Job Descriptions :

1. Supervise and coordinate daily hatchery operations to meet production plans.

2. Monitor hatchery processes, water quality, and seed quality parameters.

3. Ensure strict adherence to SOPs, biosecurity, quality, and safety standards.

4. Support production planning, scheduling, and coordination with technical teams.

5. Lead and evaluate supervisors and operational staff.

6. Report operational issues and support continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications:

1. Diploma (D3/D4) or Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Fisheries, Aquaculture, Marine Science, or a related field.

2. Minimum 2 years of experience as a Larvae Production Supervisor or 3 years of experience as a Larvae Production Technician in a shrimp hatchery.

3. Strong knowledge of shrimp hatchery operations, including larval rearing, live feed production, water quality management, and biosecurity practices.

4. Strong leadership and team management skills with the ability to oversee daily production activities and achieve production targets.

5. Good communication skills in English will be an advantage

6. Willing to travel and be placed across company units throughout Indonesia.

Deskripsi Pekerjaan :

1. Mengawasi dan mengoordinasikan operasional harian hatchery udang untuk memastikan target produksi tercapai.

2. Memantau proses hatchery, kualitas air, dan kualitas benur/larva guna menjaga performa produksi yang optimal.

3. Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap SOP, protokol biosekuriti, standar mutu, dan keselamatan kerja.

4. Mendukung perencanaan produksi, penyusunan jadwal, serta koordinasi dengan tim operasional dan teknis terkait.

5. Memimpin, mengembangkan, dan mengevaluasi kinerja supervisor serta staf

6. Laporan isu operasional, sekaligus mendorong perbaikan berkelanjutan dan penyelesaian masalah operasional.

Kualifikasi

1. Diploma (D3/D4) atau Sarjana (S1) Perikanan, Akuakultur, Ilmu Kelautan, atau bidang terkait.

2. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2 tahun sebagai Supervisor Produksi Larva atau 3 tahun sebagai Teknisi Produksi Larva di hatchery udang.

3. Memahami operasional hatchery udang, termasuk pemeliharaan larva, produksi pakan alami, manajemen kualitas air, dan penerapan biosekuriti.

4. Memiliki kemampuan kepemimpinan dan manajemen tim yang baik untuk mengelola aktivitas produksi harian serta mencapai target produksi.

5. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dalam Bahasa Inggris menjadi nilai tambah

6. Bersedia melakukan perjalanan dinas dan ditempatkan di unit perusahaan di seluruh Indonesia.

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk - Unit Makassar
Heavy Equipment Operator Feed Makassar

Job Summary
PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk is seeking a skilled and reliable Heavy Equipment Operator for our Feed Mill operations in Makassar. In this role, you will be responsible for safely and efficiently operating various types of heavy machinery to support daily raw material handling, production support, and warehouse logistics. Your primary goal is to ensure the smooth, safe, and timely movement of materials while adhering strictly to company safety standards and operational procedures.

Job Responsibilities
* Operate heavy equipment (such as wheel loaders, forklifts, and excavators) safely and efficiently to load, unload, stack, and transport raw materials and finished feed products.
* Perform daily pre-operational and post-operational inspections of the machinery to ensure it is in safe working condition, reporting any defects or maintenance needs to the supervisor immediately.
* Assist in organizing the raw material storage area and maintaining warehouse cleanliness to optimize space and ensure a safe working environment.
* Adhere strictly to the company’s Occupational Health and Safety (K3) regulations, food safety standards, and environmental policies.
* Collaborate closely with the warehouse and production teams to meet daily operational targets and dispatch schedules.
* Maintain accurate daily logs of equipment usage, fuel consumption, and material movements.

Job Qualifications
* Minimum of a High School Diploma (SMA/SMK) or equivalent.
* Must possess a valid heavy equipment operator license/certificate (SIO - Surat Izin Operasional) relevant to the machinery being operated (e.g., Loader or Forklift).
* Minimum of 2 years of proven experience as a Heavy Equipment Operator, preferably within a feed mill, food manufacturing, or large-scale warehouse environment.
* Deep understanding of heavy equipment maintenance, safety protocols, and operational safety standards (K3).
* Good physical stamina and the ability to work in a fast-paced, dusty, and noisy feed mill environment.
* Strong discipline, high responsibility, and the ability to work effectively both independently and within a team.
* Willingness to work in shifts and be stationed at the Makassar Feed Mill.

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk - Unit Makassar
Operator Alat Berat Feed Makassar

Ringkasan Pekerjaan

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk membuka kesempatan bagi kandidat yang terampil dan dapat diandalkan untuk bergabung sebagai Operator Alat Berat di operasional Feed Mill Makassar. Pada posisi ini, Anda akan bertanggung jawab mengoperasikan berbagai jenis alat berat secara aman dan efisien untuk mendukung kegiatan penanganan bahan baku, operasional produksi, dan logistik gudang. Tujuan utama dari posisi ini adalah memastikan pergerakan material berjalan lancar, aman, dan tepat waktu dengan tetap mematuhi standar keselamatan kerja serta prosedur operasional perusahaan.

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan

1.Mengoperasikan forklift (FL) sesuai dengan SOP dan Instruksi Kerja (IK) yang berlaku.

2.Melaksanakan pekerjaan rutin operasional Material Transfer (MT), yaitu melayani pemuatan pakan dengan mengoperasikan forklift listrik maupun diesel sesuai antrian permintaan ditablet.

3.Menjaga standar operasional dengan memastikan kesesuaian jenis pakan yang diminta, jumlah, dan kavling tujuan, serta menjaga kualitas, kebersihan area kerja, dan keselamatan kerja (K3) setiap saat.

4.Memastikan semua unit forklift dipakai dilakukan pengecekan sebelum di operasionalkan

5.Melakukan observasi dan pelaporan jika terdapat abnormalitas pada proses, kualitas pakan, maupun kondisi peralatan.

6.Mencatat dan melaporkan data operasional harian MT di wa grup hasil pekerjaan akhir shift

7.Melakukan serah terima shift akhir melalui briefing antar operator MT untuk memastikan kelancaran operasional.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan

1. Minimal lulusan SMA/SMK atau sederajat.

2. Memiliki SIO (Surat Izin Operasional) yang masih berlaku dan sesuai dengan jenis alat berat yang dioperasikan (Lebih Disukai).

3. Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Operator Alat Berat, diutamakan di industri feed mill, manufaktur makanan, atau gudang skala besar (Lebih Disukai).

4. Memahami dengan baik perawatan alat berat, prosedur keselamatan kerja, dan standar K3.

5. Memiliki kondisi fisik yang baik dan mampu bekerja di lingkungan feed mill yang dinamis, berdebu, dan bising.

6. Memiliki disiplin tinggi, rasa tanggung jawab yang kuat, serta mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.

7. Bersedia bekerja dalam sistem shift dan ditempatkan di Feed Mill Makassar.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
